portfolio:
```catala
scope Portfolio:
  definition exposure equals sum decimal of (map each h among holdings to if h.eligible then h.amount else 0.0)
```
bands:
```catala
scope Bands:
  definition charge equals money of (if amount <= threshold then amount * lowerRate else threshold * lowerRate + (amount - threshold) * upperRate)
```
deadline:
```catala
scope Deadline:
  date round down
  definition due equals start + months * 1 month
  definition late equals assessed > due
```
category:
```catala
scope Classification:
  definition amount equals match category with pattern
    -- Ordinary: base
    -- Preferred: base * 2
    -- Excluded: 0
```
scopes:
```catala
declaration scope Entitlement:
  input age content integer
  input rate content integer
  output amount content integer
scope Entitlement:
  definition amount equals if age >= 18 then rate else 0

scope Household:
  definition total equals sum integer of (map each person among people to (output of Entitlement with { -- age: person.age -- rate: person.rate }).amount)
```
exceptions:
```catala
scope Permission:
  label baseRule
  definition allowed equals false
  label licenseRule
  exception baseRule
  definition allowed under condition licensed consequence equals true
  exception licenseRule
  definition allowed under condition suspended consequence equals false
```
